## Why

The Round-10 schema tail (L44–52 + the appended Round-11 changes) has
never deployed on a production-shaped instance: P34.24b's clone
rehearsal died at `intake_storage`'s verify — the Cloud SQL `sig`
deploy login is not a superuser and held no membership in the NOLOGIN
intake roles its own verify `SET ROLE`s into (`D-P34.24b-1`). This row
repairs that defect the append-only way, re-rehearses the real tip on
a fresh clone (the tip moved → FEA-07(d) requires it), and lands the
L2 gate so the deploy slot can never run on a failed threshold, a
moved tip, or a missing go.

## What ships

- **`@r11-verify-membership` rework (ADR-196; L44–52 byte-identical).**
  Tagged copies `deploy|revert|verify/{intake_storage,intake_application_bridge}@r11-verify-membership.sql`
  carry the preserved scripts plus idempotent `GRANT <intake role> TO
  <current_user>` (the `materialize_role`/`recovery_apply` pattern);
  the tip deploys re-grant for already-deployed spines, tip verifies
  assert `pg_has_role`, tip reverts revoke guarded. `db/sqitch.plan`
  gains the tag + two reworked change lines — appended only, the
  L44–52 span sha256 stays `8cc9d3db…` (test-pinned).
- **Fresh-clone re-rehearsal — the production-shaped proof.** On
  `sig-pg-drill-20261009t1008z` (PIT 2026-10-09T09:58:17Z, hosted head
  `camera_site_human_decisions`): `sqitch deploy --verify` **exit 0**
  (19 changes, 141.0 s wall, `lock_timeout=1200000`ms) and `sqitch
  verify` **exit 0**; `claim_evidence` ACCESS EXCLUSIVE bound
  **15.927 s** vs the FEA-07 ceiling min(20 min, 2×13.844 s) = 27.688 s;
  temp +295.3 MiB; clone deleted; `sig-pg` untouched (read counters
  only). `D-P34.24b-1` flips **DONE** on its own success criterion.
- **`sig-ops roll-gate` (`sig.roll-gate/1`).** The L2 go/no-go on
  recorded inputs: refuses (exit 42) unless rehearsal green, lock ≤
  min(20 min, 2× the P34.24b bound), disk ≥ 2× `claim_evidence`,
  `lock_timeout` set, plan diff = 0, the P34.39a verdict `pass`, the
  AR-2 backup `SUCCESSFUL`, the verbatim go recorded with `date -u`,
  and the instant inside the window. On today's inputs it says
  **NO-GO** on exactly the three honest blockers (no read-back, no go,
  outside the window) — the gate works because it refuses.
- **L1 copy batch.** `reports/p34.46-api-roll/`: the five-line go
  request draft (deploy-as-rehearsed, ADR-159 auto-allows, the

- **Tests.** `tests/ops/test_roll_gate.py` (25 cases: every criterion

## Honest edges

- The rehearsal ran the worktree's `db/` mount (then-uncommitted); the
  committed `db/sqitch.plan` sha256 equals the rehearsed
  `9ec9511c…` — the deploy set IS the rehearsed tip.
- Clone timing is a floor on a `db-custom-1-3840` PITR copy — L2
  re-reads every threshold at the slot (the gate requires fresh
  inputs, never this record).
- P34.39a fires 10-10T03:35Z; until its verdict is `pass` the slot
  does not start — recorded, not assumed.
- The pause list is empty *for the earliest candidate slot only* — it
  is recomputed at the slot the operator picks.
- No production mutation ran beyond the authorized disposable clone;
  no human check performed; no operator go requested or fabricated.
